data.one_liner: Utilities for building and parsing URIs, including RFC 6570 template support
data.what_it_does: Provides classes to match, parse, and generate URIs. UriTemplate expands templates with data, UriParser extracts parameters, and UriBuilder helps construct URIs incrementally.
use_when: You need to generate URIs from templates
You need to parse URIs into parameters
You need a mutable URI builder
avoid_when: You need a high-level HTTP client
You need advanced routing in Flutter
strengths: Offers parsing of URI templates with restrictions
Null safety and modern Dart support
weaknesses: Parsing support is restricted to a subset of templates
